quotations.old_english: Þeáh þe heó þæs bearnes lata wǽre, heó þonne Gode (þæs bearnes MS., but see Latin) nóht lata ne wæs
quotations.latin: erat tarda soboli, sed non tarda Deo

source_text: lata. For the passage substitute :-- Þeáh þe heó þæs bearnes lata wǽre, heó þonne Gode (þæs bearnes MS., but see Latin) nóht lata ne wæs erat tarda soboli, sed non tarda Deo, Archiv cxxii. 248, 20-22; Bl. H. 163, 8. v. dǽd-lata.
